description: Moving subscriber traffic: upstream circuit, edge router, carrier-grade NAT, DHCP and DNS, backhaul links, access points at 4 sites, and about 310 customer radios
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 310 accounts lose internet at once; many customers work from home and farms run equipment monitoring over it; the home phone (and its 911 calling) rides on it; terms of service promise a prorated credit after 24 hours; RPO is the age of the last router and switch configuration copy
manual_workaround: Phone hotspot for the owner only; restore the router from the last saved configuration; a spare router is kept in the shed; tell customers through the text line and website banner
dependent_third_parties: Upstream fiber provider; radio vendor (cloud controller); site landlords for SITE-2 to SITE-4
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure); SITE-1 shed power (about 2 hours of battery; manual generator)

description: 58 VoIP lines on 52 accounts: calling, 911 calling with registered addresses, voicemail, number porting, call forwarding
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 911 calls fail when the line is down; rural mobile coverage is uneven; CPNI and 911 registered addresses live in the wholesale platform (RPO set by its backups); a wrong 911 address can send help to the wrong place
manual_workaround: Customers use mobile phones where coverage allows (the add-on terms tell them to keep one); the wholesale platform can forward lines to a mobile number on request
dependent_third_parties: Wholesale VoIP platform provider; upstream fiber provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (only person who can reach the reseller portal)

description: Support calls to the owner's mobile; text-message support line and portal chat (AI support assistant); email; website outage banner
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers must be told about outages and restoration times; CPNI may be requested through these channels, so authentication rules apply (47 CFR 64.2010)
manual_workaround: Owner answers calls from the mobile; voicemail greeting and website banner give outage status; AI assistant can be switched off and the text line answered by hand
dependent_third_parties: Billing platform vendor (text line, portal, assistant); mobile carrier

description: Monthly invoices and autopay; home phone toll charges from the monthly CDR import; collections; bookkeeping
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15,000 billed a month; autopay runs on the 1st; payments can wait a few days without loss; RPO set by the billing vendor's backups
manual_workaround: Delay the billing run; payment processor keeps taking payments through its hosted pages; personal savings cover about one month of costs
dependent_third_parties: Billing platform vendor; payment processor; bookkeeper

business_process: Installations, field service, and tower work
description: New installs, repairs, radio replacements, tower climbs with the contractor
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New installs can be rescheduled by a week; repairs of single customers fall under BP-01 support; site survey records are in the billing platform and radio controller
manual_workaround: Reschedule; keep a printed list of pending installs
dependent_third_parties: Tower and installation contractor; radio vendor
